title: Document Management | Business Operations | BackOfficeFleet
description: BOF document management support connects administrative records, customer packets, policy files, record owners, retention visibility, and workflow handoffs.
html:
Business Operations / Document Management

Make office records easy to find, review, and act on.

Documents should support an operating decision. BOF tracks the record type, purpose, owner, status, retention context, and workflow affected by the file.

Business OperationsPolicies & Procedures

Records manager lens

A document without purpose becomes a hiding place.

Administrative records, customer packets, HR files, settlement support, and policy acknowledgements need status and ownership.

Administrative records

Documents should support an operating decision, not disappear into a folder.

BOF keeps document purpose visible: what it supports, who owns it, whether it is current, and what workflow depends on it.

Record classification

Group HR records, customer packets, billing support, settlement files, policy acknowledgements, and administrative documents.

Review status

Show whether a record is current, pending review, expiring, missing, superseded, or blocked by another owner.

Retention visibility

Connect record retention expectations to policy pages without putting legal guarantees in the website copy.

Workflow handoff

Send document issues to the right operating view: driver, dispatch, safety, settlement, finance, or policy control.

Records control

Classify, review, and route records to the workflow that needs them.

Connect document status to HR, billing, settlements, policies, safety, dispatch, reporting, or leadership review.

Open Records Control
